close_reason: Proposed-config persistence and boundary regressions pass; integration remains in parent.
description:
CURRENT AUTHORIZED FOLLOW-UP: Fix review finding that proposed capability validation precedes later settings preservation. Inspect Ecto preparation order and all settings-finalization callbacks. Reuse existing preparation/snapshot/FileSettings/error paths; retain locking, identity, confidentiality and rollback. Add original tests in ChannelConfig suite for invalid restored-policy limits, unchanged persisted state, valid override, and final saved self-validation. Check grouped channel and widget policy save sequencing. Existing work must remain intact; no commits/pushes/dependency changes or unrelated refactors. Current task is specifically authorized by the user; supersedes planning-only wording below.

Planning only; implementation requires an explicit user instruction. The current handoff in parent zaq-h2i.3 is authoritative for this task and supersedes older proposed shapes and historical implementation comments. Verify live source/Git before acting; historical green logs do not validate this checkout. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md before UI work. Follow docs/testing-approach.md; existing test behavior changes require explicit approval.

Correct the existing ChannelConfig.changeset/2 persistence guard; do not introduce another save/validation service. Validate the effective proposed connection (including omitted unchanged file settings when other capability inputs change) against capabilities for that same proposal. Reuse Bridge.capability_snapshot/2 through existing channel_capability_snapshot NodeRouter/Event, CommunicationBridge normalization and FileSettings.validate/add_errors. Establish safe proposed-config request semantics through that existing operation; preserve confidential settings, actor context, provider/kind/archive checks and selected identity. No new preview endpoint.

Reuse EmailConnectorSettings.save/2, LiveUpdateSettings grouped save and WidgetConnectorSettings.execute/2 with their existing authorized Actions, revision checks and rollback. Remove the unchanged-file bypass without imposing requirements on unsupported file sending or changing unrelated flows. Keep form/operation error shapes compatible via existing FileSettings error projection. Tests in existing ChannelConfig/Engine suites cover 5 MB -> 1 MB declared-ceiling changes retaining a 4 MB override, changed override, creation, enablement, omission, valid updates and atomic grouped rollback. Read parent reuse rules before adding any function. No BO capability request on each validation event.

comments.text: Action reuse assessment: extend the existing ChannelConfig.changeset/Repo persistence boundary and channel_capability_snapshot NodeRouter/Event operation. Bridge.capability_snapshot/2 already owns selection and shared CommunicationBridge normalization; FileSettings.validate/add_errors already own field validation. Add an explicit proposed-configuration input to that same read operation (no new Action/API or BO validation), preserve provider/kind identity and confidential config transport, and validate the effective changeset for creation/update/enablement after its other preparation. Remove unchanged-file shortcuts while preserving file omission/clearing semantics and empty unsupported transports. Plan: original failing tests in ChannelConfigTest through real Repo/grouped-save boundaries using a config-dependent adapter; contract tests in BridgeTest; implement; focused regression/mix q and evidence. Existing assertions and fixtures will remain unchanged; request approval first if any conflict is discovered. No source sending/acquisition/planning, precommit, commit, or push.

TDD evidence: /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-red.log captured eight failing original example tests plus the proposed-ceiling property before implementation (110/119 passing). Both reproduced grouped saves incorrectly succeeded; omitted-file updates, creation, enablement and supplied-snapshot identity also failed. New persistence/property checks now pass after moving the shared guard last in preparation and extending the confidential snapshot event with proposed configuration input. Two pre-existing Bridge resolver tests intentionally seed missing required limits via the save changeset and now correctly fail setup; requested explicit approval under docs/testing-approach.md existing-test behavior gate to seed equivalent legacy invalid rows while preserving every assertion. No such existing fixture change has been made yet.

Independent regressions pass: 466 checks (5 properties, 461 tests) across ChannelConfig, grouped LiveUpdateSettings/ConnectorLifecycle persistence, Engine SMTP/API, Channels API/shared normalization/requirements, and both BO LiveViews; /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-regressions.log. The configured adapter is exercised through real Jido -> shared Bridge normalization and real NodeRouter/Event dispatch. Tests include retained/changed/omitted overrides, exact stored-row rollback, valid updates, creation, new enabled records, enablement and effective protected settings after preparation. Property checks compare acceptance with the proposed ceiling. mix q passed; existing Bridge fixture approval is still pending and those two tests remain unchanged.

Final independent validation: mix q passed (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-q.log); 466 focused persistence/API/LiveView checks passed, including 5 properties (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-regressions.log); existing channel and streamed-update browser checks passed 15/15 across Firefox/WebKit/Chromium (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-e2e.log). Initial browser bootstrap reported port 4002 eaddrinuse; a retry after verifying the port was free passed without code changes (initial log /tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-e2e-port-failure.log). Final owning-suite run is 118/120 passing, including its property; exactly the two pre-existing Jido/Web resolver fixtures now fail creation because their missing required limits are correctly rejected (/tmp/zaq-h2i-3-9-owning.log). Their setup and all assertions remain unchanged pending explicit approval already requested. Proposed repair: create a valid neutral fixture, then seed the same historical invalid settings with a plain fixture changeset; preserve all snapshot/resolver/isolation assertions. No new feature E2E authored; final feature UX/E2E and known full-browser RAG gap remain in their existing owners. Implementation is complete, retaining in_progress for the required fixture-approval/verification gate. No precommit, commit or push.

Reuse audit: extend existing Bridge.fetch_capability_config/2 with a proposal scope on the same capability_snapshot/2 operation. Request carries the effective ChannelConfig struct; selected existing id/provider/kind/archive identity is verified against storage, while settings/url/enabled facts come from the proposal. Existing API requires confidential events for proposals; schema prepare hook dispatches confidentially. Existing runtime/configuration/provider scopes unchanged. Extend existing maybe_validate_new_file_settings helper to prepare every retrieval update and remove unchanged-file shortcut; no new save service or Action. This additive request contract is the missing proposal semantics already explicitly planned here. Tests use a new compatible bridge fixture in the owning ChannelConfigTest, plus API confidential/identity regressions; no external adapter API is required.

Implemented confidential proposal scope on existing snapshot endpoint. Bridge checks selected provider/kind/archive identity, including built new configs with preassigned IDs, and supplies proposed settings to producers. ChannelConfig prepares all retrieval saves and removed unchanged-file bypass; data-source file payloads remain rejected. New original tests prove creation, 5MB->1MB ceiling change retaining 4MB, corrected override/false policy, enablement without settings payload, grouped rollback and API confidentiality/identity. Initial red demonstrated stale acceptance (plus corrected new-test helper invocation). Green save regression 149 checks; additional 67 ChannelConfig checks and 11 focused API checks pass. mix q final passes. Logs /tmp/zaq-h2i-proposal-{red,green,final,api,q}.log. Existing preassigned-ID regression exposed and corrected without test changes. No dependency/external edits.

Follow-up started for confirmed preparation-order review finding. Read current policies, bw prime, current Git and source. Existing 29 modified paths preserved with manifest/patch backup at /var/folders/hj/209gt2z12d1c2cf48t_2dc080000gn/T/zaq-h2i-preparation-before-uw9dbgwj. Review probes/logs are evidence only; original regressions will be added to existing suite. No change to existing test assertions or broader UX gates.

Preparation audit: Ecto.Changeset.prepare_changes prepends callbacks and Ecto.Repo.Schema.run_prepare reverses them, executing registration order. ChannelConfig registers file validation before preserve_current_policy; the latter alone changes settings in preparation (under FOR UPDATE). Widget-base-URL and IMAP SMTP dependency prepares add errors only. Grouped channel save and WidgetConnectorSettings persist ordinary fields first, then LiveUpdateSettings.persist writes policy with Ecto.Changeset.change, bypassing final capability validation. This can independently make the final record invalid. Smallest coherent plan: register existing file validation last in ChannelConfig; extend existing changeset with a compatible internal option allowing the existing authorized policy owner to preserve its submitted policy while retaining all schema validation/preparation. Default callers still restore locked current policy. LiveUpdateSettings.persist reuses that full changeset; grouped channel and widget failures reuse their existing field-error projections (extract private result-mapping from existing functions only if necessary). Concrete missing contract: the dedicated policy owner currently has no way to use the shared changeset without restoration undoing its owned write. No new validator, save operation, module or snapshot API. Preserve existing grouped sequence/revision results and rollback; do not refactor into a new save transaction. New original tests will prove direct restoration, grouped policy tightening, standalone policy validation and widget tightening plus valid lower overrides/self-validation. Fixed sequencing regression examples are appropriate; existing numeric properties remain unchanged.

Four original regressions fail before production change because invalid direct, grouped channel, policy-only and widget saves are accepted (/tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-red.log). Source fix registers file preparation last, reuses ChannelConfig.changeset with preserve_live_update_policy:false solely in the existing row-locked policy owner, and shares existing channel/widget result/error projections. First green attempt revealed an existing token-byte-preservation test: full changesets force token encryption. Policy persist now retains only its owned :settings change via existing Ecto.delete_change, preserving every unrelated field/ciphertext while retaining validation/prepares. New tests compare loaded records against loaded snapshots (EncryptedString load decrypts; inserted structs carry ciphertext); existing token assertion is untouched. No unknown failure root cause or test weakening.

Additional final-state variant exposed an intermediate-write veto after the ordering fix: a grouped change loosening the ceiling from 1MB to 5MB with a final-valid 4MB override was rejected against the old policy (new regression /tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-final-policy-red.log). Plan amendment within this fix: existing grouped transaction owners may defer only the first write\x27s capability preparation when their normalized policy actually changes; the existing final policy write always runs full shared validation before commit. Unchanged-policy saves retain ordinary validation. Extend the same internal changeset opts with defer_file_validation, default false; no bypass reachable from form attrs. Keep form conversion, row/revision locks, original operation sequence/results and final rollback. Widget uses its existing pure normalize_live_updates helper to determine whether a final policy write is guaranteed, and keeps existing error projection. This avoids both invalid acceptance and final-valid false rejection without another validator/save path.

Preparation-order review follow-up implemented and verified. ChannelConfig registers the existing capability preparation after policy restoration and other prepares. Default callers still preserve the locked authoritative policy. Existing locked LiveUpdateSettings.persist reuses the full shared changeset with preserve_live_update_policy:false and retains only its owned settings change, preserving ciphertext and unrelated fields. Grouped channel/widget operations defer capability checks only on an intermediate write when a changed normalized policy guarantees the final shared validated policy write in the same transaction; unchanged-policy saves validate normally. This handles both tightening (reject invalid 4MB under final 1MB) and loosening (allow valid 4MB under final 5MB), while retaining operation sequence, row/revision locks, confidentiality, selected identity and rollback. Existing channel/widget field-error algorithms were extracted into private result helpers and reused for final-policy failures; no second validator/save operation/module/snapshot API.

Evidence: inspected supplied review and baseline probes/logs (baseline rejects original operation). Added five original tests in existing ChannelConfigTest, with a compatible policy-dependent bridge fixture. Initial four tests proved invalid saves were accepted; /tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-red.log. Opposite-transition red proved intermediate old-policy veto, /tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-final-policy-red.log. Final tests cover direct restored/absent policy, grouped channel and widget tightening/loosening, policy-only invalidation, exact existing field errors, all persisted fields unchanged after rejection, widget routing rollback and accepted saved-record self-validation. Existing token-byte preservation assertion remains unchanged and passes. Final regression: 351 checks (7 properties, 344 tests), /tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-regression.log. Final mix q passes, /tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-q.log; git diff --check passes. Earlier quality nesting/style findings resolved via existing preparation helper and case dispatch.

Preservation: baseline backup/manifest recorded at task start; 26 of 29 existing modified files are byte-for-byte unchanged. Only ChannelConfig, WidgetConnectorSettings and ChannelConfigTest extend prior edits; LiveUpdateSettings is the sole newly modified file. No prior assertion removed/changed; only new tests and alias extensions. Exact isolated follow-up patch /tmp/zaq-h2i-preparation-fix.patch. No dependencies, UI, transport declarations, required-field applicability or unsupported-SMTP semantics changed. No commits/pushes/merges/publication. E2E not re-authored/run for this Engine-only preparation correction; focused persistence and existing BO consumers cover it. Existing feature UX/E2E/coverage/final-precommit gates remain pending; no final merge approval requested. Review this follow-up before finalizing the larger feature.
